caption:
Standing watch does not pause between incidents. Across the current collection cycle, multiple areas of interest are held under revisit — river reaches, pipeline corridors, flood-prone basins — each logged independently of whether anything is happening there.

Most passes close with no finding. That is the expected outcome, not a gap in the system. The value is in the baseline that accumulates pass over pass, so that when a signature does deviate, it deviates against a known record, not a guess.

We do not publish where the queue is currently tasked or what it has flagged. That is the point of the collection plan — it runs whether or not anyone outside it is watching.
thread: Standing watch does not pause between incidents. The collection plan runs across multiple areas of interest at once, independent of whether anything is happening in any one of them.

Most passes close with no finding. That's expected. The value is the baseline building underneath — river reaches, pipeline corridors, flood basins — logged pass over pass regardless of season or headline.
We don't publish current tasking, site count, or findings. The record exists so a deviation has something real to deviate from — not so it can be narrated in real time.

card.headline: The queue runs whether or not anything is happening
card.sub: Multiple areas of interest held under standing revisit, pass over pass, independent of incident or season.

rationale: Shows operational scale and discipline (multi-AOI, continuous tasking) without naming a single site, client, or detection — reinforcing credibility through abstraction rather than specifics.
